name: Qobuz
summary: Stream Qobuz on {player}, or play to it from the Qobuz app.
description: Browse and play Qobuz in Kalinka Player, or pick Kalinka Player as a speaker in the Qobuz app with Qobuz Connect. You need a paid Qobuz subscription. Not made or endorsed by Qobuz.

notes: Requires Kalinka Player server 5.12.0 or newer (below 6.0.0), which brings plugin SDK 3.14, and Python 3.11 or newer.
An active Qobuz subscription is required. This integration is not endorsed by Qobuz.
The package is architecture-independent but requires a compatible Debian-packaged Kalinka Player server and resolvable Python dependencies. It is not a macOS, Windows or RPM package.
Initial distro allowlist is Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04. Upstream describes broader Debian-family support; expand the curated list only after review.
Qobuz Connect pairing requires local-network mDNS (UDP 5353) and TCP 8183 by default; playback handoffs also need an outbound WebSocket connection.
